pressed_detection_rule: Inside each fixed search window, take the tight bounding box of beige button-face pixels (R 175-235, G 155-220, B 135-200, R-B>=8). Pressed if min(width, height) <= 93. Unpressed buttons measure about 98-101 px; pressed buttons measure about 88-90 px and sit ~4 px down-right. Threshold sits in the empty gap.
notes: Buttons are the HTML5 QWOP Q/W (thighs, top-left of the game) and O/P (calves, top-right). Right side of the recording is LiveSplit and a keyboard cam; those keys were not used. Native 60 fps.
preroll_note: Frame 0 through about t=1s shows the runner frozen near 75.4-75.7 metres with LiveSplit at 0.00 and all four on-screen buttons unpressed. By t=2.0s the distance readout is 0.3 metres and the first button presses begin (O at 2.01667s, W at 2.05000s, Q at 2.81667s, P at 2.91667s). Last press samples: Q 47.40000s, W 46.50000s, O 47.18333s, P 46.45000s. That span is consistent with the 45.530s race starting near video t=2s; the timeline itself is video time, not in-game time, and continues through the results screen to 55.88333s.

spotcheck.note: Red box = predicted pressed, green = predicted up. Size classes never overlapped (pressed min-dim 88-90, unpressed 96-101, zero frames in 94-95).
